These are synthetic parser-only fixtures, not reports from a native IDE run. The concrete root ValidationSuite omits type; polymorphic children and result include type. Schema is source-grounded in JetBrains/educational-plugin commit 6b77322dcfc0fbab8c3e94ab5055b3f72d74460c, ValidationResultNode.kt and JsonValidationResultConsumer.kt. Tests also mutate the golden fixture to cover ignored, failed, missing, duplicate, unknown, and malformed results. No fixture can be uploaded as course output.
